locator.text: Display 151.3, p. 151, in the proof of Lemma B.4

evidence: paper: p_{1,\mathrm{r}}(y) \;\ge\; p_{1,\mathrm{r}}(0) e^{-y} + 1.88 \, \chi \big( e^{y} - e^{-y} \big), \qquad p_{1,\mathrm{r}}(X) \;\ge\; p_{1,\mathrm{r}}(X_0) \frac{X_0}{X} + 1.2 \left( X - \frac{X_0^2}{X} \right)

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean uses a different formula here. Second display: matched and slightly stronger in Lean, under extra hypotheses that the reference profile meets. p1_lower_from_initial (ReferenceBounds.lean:202–209) gives p_1(X) ≥ p_1(a)·a/X + (q/(2L))·(X − a²/X) from q ≤ S_q on [a,X] together with 0 < a ≤ X, 0 ≤ b, 0 ≤ q, 0 < P.f on [0,X] and AntitoneOn (fun s => P.f (s,η)) (Icc 0 X). The antitonicity is Lean's stand-in for the paper's l_r ≤ 1 in (B.23) (l_r = 1 + X ∂_X f / f, so l_r ≤ 1 iff ∂_X f ≤ 0), and it is discharged for the reference profile by reference_antitone (ReferenceBounds.lean:930), which is exactly how bounds_from_sources supplies it (lines 1086 and 1121, alongside positivity of f from refF_pos); so the comparison is fair. With a = X_0 = 4/Λ and q = 12/5 (the additive 2.4 of (B.23)) the coefficient is 1.2/L ≥ 1.2, since L ≤ 1 by NaturalEntrance.L_le_one, so Lean's constant is at least the paper's. First display: no counterpart was found. The Lean never solves the p_1 equation in the logarithmic variable y = log(X/X_0); there is no declaration containing the Gronwall/integrating-factor solution formula p_1(0)e^{−y} + 1.88χ(e^y − e^{−y}). Its consequence is reached by another route: lower_comparison_preserves/p1_preserves_lower show algebraically that a lower bound b at X_0 persists for all X ≥ X_0 provided b·L ≤ q·X_0, and bounds_from_sources instantiates this at b = 23/10 with q·X_0 = (94/25)·L·χ — numerically the paper's own condition, since (94/25)χ ≥ 23/10 is 1.88χ ≥ 2.3/2, i.e. exactly what the paper's exponential formula is used for (that p_{1,r} stays above 2.3 once χ ≥ .99). Severity low: the surrounding conclusions of Lemma B.4 (the cone margin p_1 ≥ 2.3 on the hold region, and 3 < p_1(100,η)) are proved, only not through the paper's exponential formula.
